eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 8:53 PM on SEP 3, 2026 Effective until 4:53 AM SEP 4, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
A SAFE Alert has been issued for Phoenix Police Department. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. Phoenix PD is looking for Martin Lopez. He is a 74-year-old Hispanic male, five foot 3 inches, 180 pounds, brown eyes and gray hair. Martin was last seen near 25th Ave. and McLellan Blvd. wearing a white and gray striped polo shirt with gray shorts. Martin suffers from a medical condition which may cause him to become easily confused or lost.
